subject: Rustic Harbor private deployment onboarding — environment readiness & checklist
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa King <alyssa.king@rusticharbor.com>, IT Ops <itops@rusticharbor.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Rustic Harbor private deployment onboarding — environment readiness & checklist

Hi Alyssa / IT team,

Great to meet you earlier this week. Per our call, attaching the initial onboarding checklist and a condensed network diagram so your architects have what they need for the VPC/on-prem handoff. Key asks to validate before we schedule the environment activation window: 

- Service account and principal names (IAM) for Redwood runtime
- IP allowlist / peering details and egress policy
- KMS/HSM key access model and a point of contact for key rotation
- Expected peak concurrent LLM connections and typical sequence lengths (for batching/slots)
- Any corporate firewall or proxy that requires explicit rules

I attached: RHH-Runtime-Network-Diagram-v1.pdf, redwood-onboarding-checklist.xlsx.

Proposed next steps:
1) Your team confirms the first three checklist items by EOD Friday (Aug 6)
2) We book a 60-min runbook walkthrough (network + KMS) for early next week
3) Once items are green, we schedule a 4-hour activation window for the private deployment (can be evening UTC to minimize impact).

If there are procurement/contract questions, loop in procurement@rusticharbor.com — Priyom, Monica: FYI on procurement and SOC2 evidence requests.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: RHH-Runtime-Network-Diagram-v1.pdf, redwood-onboarding-checklist.xlsx
From: Alyssa King <alyssa.king@rusticharbor.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: IT Ops <itops@rusticharbor.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 06 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Rustic Harbor private deployment onboarding — environment readiness & checklist

Hi Ben / team,

Thanks — useful summary. Quick responses below (we'll provide formal answers in a spreadsheet later today):

- Service accounts: We'll create two principals: redwood-runtime@rhh (for serving) and redwood-ops@rhh (for console/ops actions).
- IP/Peering: We can support peering into our tenant; prefer static IP ranges. Draft CIDRs in the attached diagram look fine; we'll confirm exact prefixes.
- KMS: We use an HSM-backed KeyVault (Azure Key Vault Dedicated HSM). We'll need an ARN-equivalent for your KMS integration. Security team wants to review limited key usage policies.
- Traffic profile: Peak concurrent 120 connections, most requests under 1024 tokens.
- Firewall: Outbound proxy restricts direct internet TLS on non-standard ports; we'll need a list of egress endpoints.

Attachments: RHH-Runtime-answers.xlsx (I put the confirmed CIDRs and service account names). Also procurement has a few contract questions — cc'd procurement.

On timing: We'll confirm the walkthrough slot by EOD.

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa King
Head of IT, Rustic Harbor Health
attachments: RHH-Runtime-answers.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa King <alyssa.king@rusticharbor.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, IT Ops <itops@rusticharbor.com>
Date: Thu, 06 Aug 2026 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Rustic Harbor private deployment onboarding — environment readiness & checklist

Thanks Alyssa — that aligns with what we expected. Two clarifications before the walkthrough: 

1) KMS/HSM mapping: Can your security team provide the KMS principal and a sample policy snippet that we can test in the staging key access flow?
2) Egress endpoints: I'll share a minimal list of endpoints (control plane, telemetry, and runtime update checks). Please add any internal proxies we should route through.

I've attached an updated onboarding spreadsheet with the fields we'll collect during the walkthrough, and I added a preliminary runbook for the activation window.

Proposed walkthrough slots (PST): Mon Aug 9 10:00-11:00, Mon Aug 9 16:00-17:00, Tue Aug 10 08:00-09:00. Which works best?

Ben
attachments: redwood-onboarding-checklist.xlsx

Ben / Monica — prepping for the Mon walkthrough at 10:00. Short checklist of what I'll cover from the Redwood side: 

- Confirm runtime image hashes and the minimal container runtime required for HSM access.
- Validate runtime config for prefix/KV caching and batch slot sizing (120 peak concurrent -> recommend 24 slots).
- Prepare sample KMS policy (scoped to decrypt only for redwood-runtime@rhh) and a stubbed rotation plan.
- Compile egress endpoint list (control plane, telemetry, metrics ingest).
- Bring the activation runbook and a rollback plan with exact steps to revoke peering and stop serving if an issue arises.

Monica — can you handle the SOC2 evidence packet requested in procurement's thread? I attached a zipped sample of what they typically want (SOC2 evidence bundle) — once procurement confirms exact items we can hand over a scoped bundle.

Priyom
